values/minecraftServer.externalIPs.description:
loadBalancerSourceRanges: []
Set the externalTrafficPolicy in the Service to either Cluster or Local
externalTrafficPolicy: Cluster

apiKey.description: CurseForge API key obtained from developer console

envFrom.description:
Additional environment variables to add to the minecraft container from
ConfigMaps and Secrets

extraDeploy.description:
Array of extra objects to deploy with the release
extraDeploy:
- |
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
name: {{ template "minecraft.fullname" . }}-extra-cm
data:
key: |-
{
"key": "value"
}

extraEnv.description:
Additional minecraft container environment variables
Values can be either variable values or `valueFrom` yaml

extraPodSpec.description:
Extra fields to set on the pod
Fields set here will be added to the end of the Pod spec
Can include any fields from https://kubernetes.io/docs/reference/kubernetes-api/workload-resources/pod-v1/#PodSpec
that are not already set by the chart.
The value of the field will be interpretted as a template.
extraPodSpec:
priorityClassName: 'my-priority-class'

extraVolumes.description:
extraVolumes:
- volumeMounts:
- name: nfs
mountPath: /mnt/volume
readOnly: true
volumes:
- name: nfs
nfs:
server: some.nfs.server.com
path: /
mountOptions:
- port=2049
- hard
- vers=4

initContainers.description:
Array of initContainers to add to include in deployment (supports templating)
initContainers:
- name: do-something
image: busybox
command: ['do', 'something']
volumeMounts:
- name: nfs
mountPath: /mnt/volume
readOnly: true
- |
name: {{ template "minecraft.fullname" . }}-init
image: busybox
command: ['do', 'something']
volumeMounts:
- name: nfs
mountPath: /mnt/volume
readOnly: true

livenessProbe.description:
Most of these map to environment variables. See Minecraft for details:
https://hub.docker.com/r/itzg/minecraft-server/

mcbackup.description: PLEASE NOTE! rcon must be enabled above!  It does NOT require a nodePort or loadBalancerIP

allowNether.description: Allows players to travel to the Nether.

announcePlayerAchievements.description: Allows server to announce when a player gets an achievement.

apiKey.description: CurseForge API key obtained from developer console

bukkitDownloadUrl.description: If type is set to BUKKIT, this sets the URL to download the Bukkit package

cfServerMod.description: If type is set to CURSEFORGE, this sets the server mod to run. Can also provide url to curseforge package.

difficulty.description: One of: peaceful, easy, normal, and hard

downloadModpackUrl.description: If set, the modpack at this URL will be downloaded at startup

downloadWorldUrl.description: If set, this URL will be downloaded at startup and used as a starting point

enforceSecureProfile.description: Require public key to be signed by Mojang to join

eula.description: This must be overridden, since we can't accept this for the user.

extraServiceSpec.description: Additional service specs to be defined

fabricLauncherVersion.description:
If type is set to FABRIC, this sets the version of fabric server launcher
to use. Defaults to latest available for minecraftServer.version.
For a custom launcher, see: https://docker-minecraft-server.readthedocs.io/en/latest/types-and-platforms/server-types/fabric/

fabricLoaderVersion.description:
If type is set to FABRIC, this sets the version of fabric-loader to use.
Defaults to latest available for minecraftServer.version.

forcegameMode.description: If true, players will always join in the default gameMode even if they were previously set to something else.

forgeInstallerUrl.description: If type is set to FORGE, this sets the URL to download the Forge installer

forgeVersion.description: If type is set to FORGE, this sets the version; this is ignored if forgeInstallerUrl is set

ftbLegacyJavaFixer.description: Set to true if running Feed The Beast and get an error like "unable to launch forgemodloader"

ftbModpackId.description: If type is set to FTBA, this sets the modpack to run

ftbModpackVersionId.description: If type is set to FTBA and a modpack is set, this sets the version to run

gameMode.description: One of: creative, survival, adventure, spectator

generateStructures.description: Defines whether structures (such as villages) will be generated.

generatorSettings.description:
When levelType == FLAT or CUSTOMIZED, this can be used to further customize map generation.
ref: https://hub.docker.com/r/itzg/minecraft-server/

hardcore.description: If set to true, players will be set to spectator mode if they die.

icon.description: A server icon URL for server listings. Auto-scaled and transcoded.

jvmOpts.description: General JVM options to be passed to the Minecraft server invocation

jvmXXOpts.description: Options like -X that need to proceed general JVM options

levelSeed.description: Define this if you want a specific map generation seed.

levelType.description: One of: DEFAULT, FLAT, LARGEBIOMES, AMPLIFIED, CUSTOMIZED

maxBuildHeight.description: The maximum height in which building is allowed.

maxTickTime.description: The maximum number of milliseconds a single tick may take before the server watchdog stops the server with the message. -1 disables this entirely.

maxWorldSize.description: This sets the maximum possible size in blocks, expressed as a radius, that the world border can obtain.

memory.description: If you adjust this, you may need to adjust resources.requests above to match.

modUrls.description:
List with URLs and paths to jar files, additionally may be a directory with jars
This works for both mods and plugins depending on server type

modrinth.description: A list of Modrinth project slugs with optional version after colon

allowedVersionType.description: The version type is used to determine the newest version to use from each project. The allowed values are: release, beta, alpha

downloadDependencies.description: Specifies whether to download Modrinth dependencies. The allowed values are: none, required, optional

nodePort.description: Set the port used if the serviceType is NodePort

onlineMode.description: Check accounts against Minecraft account service.

ops.description: A comma-separated list of player names who should be admins.

paperDownloadUrl.description: If type is set to PAPER, this sets the URL to download the PaperSpigot package

enabled.description: If you enable this, your server will be "published" to Gamespy
If you enable this, make SURE to change your password below.

nodePort.description: Set the external port if the rcon serviceType is NodePort

withGeneratedPassword.description:
By default, the container will generate a random password at startup
to ensure internal RCON tooling, including a backup container,
can be used, but the password is secure.

removeOldMods.description: If true, old versions of downloaded mods will be replaced with new ones from downloadModpackUrl

resourcePackEnforce.description: When true, players will be prompted for a response and will be disconnected if they decline the required pack

resourcePackSha.description:
Optional SHA-1 digest of the resource pack, in lowercase hexadecimal.
It is recommended to specify this, because it is used to verify the integrity of the resource pack.

resourcePackUrl.description: Optional URI to a resource pack. The player may choose to use it.

servicePort.description: Set the external port of the service, usefull when using the LoadBalancer service type

spawnAnimals.description: Determines if animals will be able to spawn.

spawnMonsters.description: Determines if monsters will be spawned.

spawnNPCs.description: Determines if villagers will be spawned.

spawnProtection.description: Sets the area that non-ops can not edit (0 to disable)

spigetResources.description: A list of Spigot resources/plugins IDs to download.

spigotDownloadUrl.description: If type is set to SPIGOT, this sets the URL to download the Spigot package

spongeVersion.description: If type is set to SPONGEVANILLA, this sets the version

tty.description: set this to false to not have colorized logs

type.description:
The type of Minecraft server to run, check for related settings below
Common types: "VANILLA", "FABRIC", "FORGE", "SPIGOT", "BUKKIT", "PAPER",
"FTBA", "SPONGEVANILLA", "AUTO_CURSEFORGE"
ref: https://docker-minecraft-server.readthedocs.io/en/latest/types-and-platforms

vanillaTweaksShareCodes.description: A list of VanillaTweaks Share Codes to download. (https://vanillatweaks.net/share#wUq1iz => "wUq1iz")

version.description: One of: LATEST, SNAPSHOT, or a specific version (ie: "1.7.9").

whitelist.description: A comma-separated list of player names to whitelist.

replicaCount.description:
WARNING ###
Minecraft is not horizontally scalable, adjusting this will most likely break your setup.
WARNING ###

resources.description:
Configure resource requests and limits
ref: http://kubernetes.io/docs/user-guide/compute-resources/

sidecarContainers.description:
Array of additional sidecards to include in the deployment (supports templating)
sidecarContainers:
- name: do-something
image: busybox
command: ['do', 'something']
volumeMounts:
- name: nfs
mountPath: /mnt/volume
readOnly: true
- |
name: {{ template "minecraft.fullname" . }}-sidecar
image: busybox
command: ['do', 'something', 'with', 'rcon']
env:
- name: RCON_PASSWORD
valueFrom:
secretKeyRef:
name: '{{ .Values.minecraftServer.rcon.existingSecret | default (printf "%s-rcon" (include "minecraft.fullname" .)) }}'
key: "{{ .Values.minecraftServer.rcon.secretKey | default "rcon-password" }}"

strategyType.description:
upgrade strategy type, depending on workload type:
- for Deployment sets strategy: Recreate or RollingUpdate
- for StatefulSet sets updateStrategy: OnDelete or RollingUpdate

workloadAsStatefulSet.description:
If true the workload is defined as a StatefulSet instead of a Deployment.
Make sure to also update the strategyType!
All configuration options for the Deployment (e.g. annotations) are used for the StatefulSet.
Regarding persistence: When an existing PVC is provided it will be shared between all Pods.
Otherwise the PVC configuration is used as a template to create PVCs for each replica.
